name: Romania
fact: The Danube Delta Biosphere Reserve safeguards Europe's largest wetland ecosystem, harboring vast reed beds and providing vital sanctuary for hundreds of migratory bird species.

name: Russia
fact: Plunging more than a mile deep in Siberia, ancient Lake Baikal contains one-fifth of Earth's unfrozen freshwater and shelters thousands of unique endemic species.

name: San Marino
fact: Three iconic medieval fortresses crown the limestone peaks of Mount Titano, offering sweeping vistas of the surrounding Apennine countryside and the Adriatic Sea.

name: Serbia
fact: Deep in the Dinaric Alps, Tara National Park shelters the rare Serbian spruce, an ancient botanical treasure that survived prehistoric ice ages.

name: Slovakia
fact: With hundreds of fortified châteaux and ruins dotting its green hillsides, Slovakia features one of the world's highest concentrations of historic castles per capita.

name: Slovenia
fact: Surrounded by the snow-dusted Julian Alps, the emerald waters of Lake Bled encircle Slovenia's sole natural island, famed for its picturesque cliffside church.

name: Spain
fact: Antoni Gaudí's visionary architecture graces Barcelona, where the soaring, nature-inspired towers of the Sagrada Família showcase an extraordinary triumph of artistic engineering.

name: Sweden
fact: Swedish engineer Nils Bohlin invented the three-point seatbelt in 1959, a life-saving design that Volvo made freely available to all automobile manufacturers.

name: Switzerland
fact: Engineers carved the fifty-seven-kilometer Gotthard Base Tunnel directly through Alpine granite, creating the world's longest and deepest subterranean rail passage.

name: Ukraine
fact: Adorned with radiant eleventh-century mosaics and frescoes, Kyiv's Saint Sophia Cathedral stands as a magnificent UNESCO-listed treasure of medieval art and architecture.

name: United Kingdom
fact: In 1928, Scottish scientist Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin at St Mary's Hospital, inaugurating modern antibiotics and saving hundreds of millions of lives worldwide.

name: Vatican City
fact: Vatican City is the only sovereign state in the world inscribed in its entirety as a UNESCO World Heritage site, safeguarding centuries of celebrated art and architecture.
